title: Transition compatibility for explicit adjoints of a module system
statement: Let X, S_n, Y_n be schemes [def-pc-scheme], j_n:S_n→X, p_n:Y_n→S_n, i_n:S_n→S_(n+1), g_n:Y_n→Y_(n+1). Assume i_n≫j_(n+1)=j_n, g_n≫p_(n+1)=p_n≫i_n, and g_n≫(p_(n+1)≫j_(n+1))=p_n≫j_n. Let c_n be the inverse of the explicit mate tensorPullbackCompositionIso [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. For an X-module G and maps a_n:j_n^*G→p_(n,*)O_Yn [def-pc-module-pullback], assume i_n^*(a_(n+1)) followed by structure-sheaf base change equals c_n(G) followed by a_n [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-algebra]. Define t_n:G→(p_n≫j_n)_*O_Yn as the adjunction unit, j_(n,*)(a_n), and pushforward composition. Then g_n.appLE(t_(n+1)(x))=t_n(x) on every open U and section x of G(U). No finite, proper, coherent, cartesian or invertible hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Apply unit_conjugateEquiv_symm to the pinned adjunctions and canonical pushforward comparison. Cancel c inverse followed by c to obtain the composite unit equation.

Take the adjunction for i of the compatibility equation and push it forward along j. Naturality moves a through the unit; moduleBaseChangeMap_algebra identifies the adjoint base-change composite with the structure map of g. Naturality of the pushforward comparison and the mate unit equation simplify the right side.

Evaluate the module equation on U and x. Pushforward composition is the identity on sections. PushforwardCongr is a restriction between equal inverse-image opens; combine these restrictions by functoriality. The resulting open morphism is appLE, by uniqueness of morphisms in a poset. This is implemented as Subsingleton.elim in Lean.

lean.statement: theorem finiteStructureAdjoint_transitions (X : Scheme.{u}) (S Y : ℕ → Scheme.{u}) (j : ∀ n, S n ⟶ X) (p : ∀ n, Y n ⟶ S n) (i : ∀ n, S n ⟶ S (n + 1)) (g : ∀ n, Y n ⟶ Y (n + 1)) (wj : ∀ n, i n ≫ j (n + 1) = j n) (wp : ∀ n, g n ≫ p (n + 1) = p n ≫ i n) (w : ∀ n, g n ≫ (p (n + 1) ≫ j (n + 1)) = p n ≫ j n) (c : ∀ n, tensorPullback (j (n + 1)) ⋙ tensorPullback (i n) ≅ tensorPullback (j n)) (hc : ∀ n, c n = (tensorPullbackCompositionIso (i n) (j (n + 1)) (j n) (wj n)).symm) (G : X.Modules) (a : ∀ n, (tensorPullback (j n)).obj G ⟶ (pushforward (p n)).obj (SheafOfModules.unit (Y n).ringCatSheaf)) (ha : ∀ n, (tensorPullback (i n)).map (a (n + 1)) ≫ (moduleBaseChangeMap (p (n + 1)) (p n) (i n) (g n) (wp n) (SheafOfModules.unit (Y (n + 1)).ringCatSheaf) ≫ (pushforward (p n)).map (tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit (g n))) = (c n).hom.app G ≫ a n) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (x : Γ(G, U)), ((g n).appLE ((p (n + 1) ≫ j (n + 1)) ⁻¹ᵁ U) ((p n ≫ j n) ⁻¹ᵁ U) (by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, w n])).hom ((finiteStructureAdjoint (j (n + 1)) (p (n + 1)) G (a (n + 1))).app U x) = (finiteStructureAdjoint (j n) (p n) G (a n)).app U x
